manifest.name: Price dashboard
manifest.description: A dashboard of things whose value changes: a big number with its change (day / week / month / year; real 1-day and 1-week charts for crypto), a watchlist, a detail page and 4 stat tiles. Live crypto prices from CoinGecko. Fits: crypto prices, savings, scores. Prices only, no advice.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

currency.desc: symbol before values, e.g. $ or EUR sign, or empty string for plain numbers

price.desc: current value; for a coin with cg put 0 (the live feed fills it)

chg.desc: % change; for a coin with cg put 0s (the live feed fills them)

cg.desc: CoinGecko coin id for live prices (e.g. avalanche-2, bitcoin); leave out for anything else

held.desc: units held; leave out for a plain watchlist

stats.desc: the 4 tiles on top (for crypto with live_stats true they show the first coin’s live facts instead: put "–" values)

hero_label.desc: label of the big number on top

live_stats.desc: true: the 4 tiles show the first item’s live facts

items.name: Avalanche
items.about: A fast, low-fee smart-contract platform: a primary network plus custom Layer 1 chains that each set their own rules.

items.name: Bitcoin
items.about: The first cryptocurrency: a fixed supply of 21 million coins, secured by proof-of-work mining since 2009.

items.name: Ethereum
items.about: A programmable blockchain for smart contracts, stablecoins and decentralised apps.

items.name: Solana
items.about: A high-throughput blockchain built for fast, low-fee payments and consumer apps.

items.name: XRP
items.about: The token of the XRP Ledger, a network built for fast cross-border payments.

items.name: Chainlink
items.about: An oracle network that brings outside data, such as prices and weather, onto blockchains.

notes_for_juli: Prices and facts only: never advice, predictions or buy / sell / hold words. For crypto, give each item its CoinGecko id in cg (avalanche-2, bitcoin, ethereum, solana, ripple, chainlink, dogecoin, cardano, polkadot, litecoin) and put price 0 and every chg 0: the app shows only live CoinGecko numbers for those and never the slot values. Keep AVAX first unless the person asks for other coins. For anything that is not crypto (savings, scores), leave cg out, use only numbers the person gave, set live_stats false and write 4 simple stat tiles; use currency "" for plain numbers. Leave held out unless the person gives amounts.
